recipes.label: Isolated image runtime
recipes.limitations: Exact dependency versions and worker pipeline imports are checked, then a CUDA kernel is executed. Model inference is verified only by a real completed generation. CPU offload still requires enough host RAM for the selected published checkpoint.

recipes.label: Isolated Whisper runtime
recipes.limitations: Uses the existing pinned speech preparation script and verifies its isolated interpreter. CPU inference is allowed; CUDA is checked when available. No checkpoint is downloaded by dependency preparation.

recipes.label: Isolated Phonon reference runtime
recipes.limitations: Preserves the installed Fermion checkpoint and both BF16/FP32 choices. Derived dense runtime caches remain separate and precision specific. Inference is verified only by transcription.

recipes.label: Managed Android SDK and emulator
recipes.limitations: The command-line tools archive is SHA-256 pinned. Google resolves stable SDK package revisions; installed revisions are recorded. Requires an existing Java 17+ runtime and working hardware virtualization. The setup never enables Windows features or reboots the host.

recipes.label: VirtualBox host tools
recipes.limitations: Reuses installed VirtualBox when present. Otherwise downloads the SHA-256 pinned Windows x64 installer and requests Windows administrator permission. A host installation and a working guest OS are separate checks. No Extension Pack or operating system is downloaded.

recipes.label: Managed PC testing VM from a licensed ISO
recipes.limitations: Creates a new managed VM using an existing user-selected licensed ISO and a password held in a named environment variable. Existing VMs are not changed. Guest readiness requires Guest Additions and a successful guest command after unattended installation; unsupported ISOs fail explicitly.
